<table border="0" align="center" style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
  <tr>
    <td>
    With the <b>{pad:data}</b> tag it is possible to define data for later use.
</td>
  </tr>
</table>
  

<p> 
  <table border="1" cellpadding="10" cellspacing="0" class="pad-play-box">
    <tr>
      
      
      
      <th bgcolor="#dddddd">HTML</th>
      <th bgcolor="#dddddd">RESULT<link rel="stylesheet" href="/pad/_common/play.css?v=0710b25258"><a class="pad-play" href="/pad/wasm/#" title="Try it in WASM" aria-label="Try this example in WASM"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-play" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7Z"/></svg></a><a class="pad-play pad-live" href="/pad/live/#" title="Run it live, as a page of this server" aria-label="Run this example as a page of this server"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-zap" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13.5 2.5L5 13.5h6.5l-1 8 8.5-11h-6.5Z"/></svg></a></th>
    </tr>
    <tr><td style="vertical-align:top"><!-- START DEMO SOURCE --><pre><code style="color: #000000"><b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">pad</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>data </font><font color="red"><font color="black">'</font>myData<font color="black">'</font></font>}</b><br>  [<br>    { "name": "joe",   "phone": "555-3425" },<br>    { "name": "jim",   "phone": "555-2364" },<br>    { "name": "jack",  "phone": "555-3422" },<br>    { "name": "jerry", "phone": "555-4973" }<br>  ]<br><b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">pad</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>data</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br><br>&lt;table border="1"&gt;<br>  <b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">data</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>myData</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br>    &lt;tr&gt;<br>      &lt;td&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>name</font>}</b>&lt;/td&gt; <br>      &lt;td&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>phone</font>}</b>&lt;/td&gt;<br>    &lt;/tr&gt;  <br>  <b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">data</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>myData</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br>&lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><!-- END DEMO SOURCE --></td><td style="vertical-align:top"><code><span style="color: #000000"><!-- START DEMO RESULT --><table border="1">
  
    <tr>
      <td>joe</td> 
      <td>555-3425</td>
    </tr>  
  
    <tr>
      <td>jim</td> 
      <td>555-2364</td>
    </tr>  
  
    <tr>
      <td>jack</td> 
      <td>555-3422</td>
    </tr>  
  
    <tr>

    </tr>  
  
</table><!-- END DEMO RESULT --></span></code></td></tr>
  </table>
</p>

<table border="0" align="center" style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
  <tr>
    <td>
  Data can be in xml/json/yaml/csv format.
  <br><br>
  There is also an own PAD list format with opening ( and closing )</p>
</td>
  </tr>
</table>

<table border="0" align="center" style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
  <tr>
    <td>
<p>
If <b>{pad:data 'xxx'}</b> is used, then the data will not be processed before it is stored in the data store,<br>all above examples use it in this way.</p>
<p>If <b>{/pad:data 'xxx'}</b> is used, then the data will be processed before it is stored in the data store.<br> Below a crazy example how this can be used: <br>
- first there is a JSON data definition<br>
- then this JSON data is converted to CSV data<br>
- then this CSV data is converted to XML data<br>
- then this XML data is converted to YAML data<br>
- then this YAML data is used to show a HTML table.
</td>
  </tr>
</table>
